svg.text: PRODUCTIVE · PRODUCTIVITY ENHANCEMENT · PART 4.1 · PROGRESSIVE SUMMARISATION
PARA told you where to put a note. This makes the note worth keeping — feed a topic more material and the map stays the same size while its resolution climbs.
new material · a topic you already have a map for

W = CONSTANT · 1 MAP · FOOTPRINT NEVER GROWS
RESOLUTION ↑ · climbs as you feed it more
the keystone — same inputs, two outcomes
MAP — same SIZE, grows SHARPER (footprint flat · resolution ↑)
HOARD (grows longer = the failure, drawn grey)
every instinct says learning = a growing pile. it isn't.
saved beside the map, not into it
Every input has one job: sharpen an existing map — or it isn't kept. The summary doesn't grow longer as you learn more; it grows sharper.
same shape as 3.1 — write the improvement back into the durable artifact
INTEGRATE is a learning rep disguised as note-keeping
